messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty HIGH CRITICAL: p99 latency spike on /v1/generate — p99=1200ms, SLO p99=500ms, SLO burn 22% over 10m. Pager: pd-ops.

alice oncall: Acked. I'm on it. ping @bob infra @sasha sre

bob infra: Seeing sustained tail qps ~2.3x from eu-west; sidecar CPU at 92% on pool-3, batcher queue length growing, shard5 showing hotkey activity. Suspect KV-cache churn + backpressure.

matt runtime: Correlating logs, lots of cache misses and forced flushes. snippet:
```
2026-03-18T15:10:12Z batcher.cpp: enqueue 64 tokens -> flush
evict: model_kv: shard5 hotkey key=usr-12345
```

sasha sre: Any deploys in last 30m? Could be a config regression.

alice oncall: No deploys per deploy-bot. @deploy-bot confirm?

deploy-bot: (automated) No active deploys in last 60m.

bob infra: Quick mitigation plan: 1) temporarily reduce max_batch_size -> 32 on eu-west sidecar pool. 2) scale sidecar replicas +2 in eu-west. 3) enable fallback routing for premium routes to dedicated nodes.

alice oncall: Applying change 1 & 2 now. Will monitor.

alice oncall: PATCH applied: sidecar eu-west replicas 6 -> 8, max_batch_size 64 -> 32. waiting ~90s for warmup. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt runtime: After scale, KV miss rate down ~30%, sidecar CPU dropping to ~68%. p99 trending -> 620ms.

charles support: Seeing customer reports: increased streaming errors. How many impacted?

alice oncall: Early telemetry estimate ~4% of streaming sessions experienced timeouts in last 15m. Keeping PD open until p99 < 500ms for 10m.

sasha sre: Also toggling fallback routing to dedicated nodes for high-priority tenants for 15 minutes to reduce user-facing impact. Doing now.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Acknowledgement recorded by alice oncall. Escalation suppressed.

alice oncall: Handing off to evening on-call @bob infra in 12m. Notes: root cause likely KV-cache churn from hotkey + batcher backpressure; mitigations applied: scaled sidecars, reduced batch_size, enabled fallback routing. Please watch shard5 hotkey and KV eviction rate. :memo:

bob infra: Taking over. I will keep an eye on p99 and the hotkey traffic. If we see re-burn, plan B is to pin heavy clients to dedicated pools and force prewarm of KV keys.

incident-bot: SLO update: p99 = 480ms, SLO burn down to 4.8% over 5m.

alice oncall: Marking as mitigated for now. Leaving incident open for postmortem and customer comms. :white_check_mark:

charles support: Notifying affected customers with ETA window ~30m for full recovery. Creating support docket.

bob infra: Will run follow-up: collect heap of KV eviction traces, batch size histograms, and check autoscaler logs. Postmortem owner: bob infra.

incident-bot: Incident bot: Incident state = mitigated (active monitoring).

alice oncall: Thanks team — handing off. bob, ping if anything flares. :thumbsup:
